name: portal-remote-trigger-detector
notes: Comparator-hopper detector variant of portal-remote-trigger: NO pressure plates. The item out of R_O falls straight into the west collecting hoppers (1621, z 1..2); comparators west of them (1620) read their inventory (1 item = signal 1), repeaters (1619) amplify into the stone strip (1618) and the dust line on top of it fires the dropper into D_O. Each detector hopper drains down into a barrel below it (1621, y57) after its own post-suck transfer cooldown, so the pulse holds for the comparator+repeater delays and then resets. The east hoppers (1622) face west into the detectors. Trip 1 is summoned low (y59.3, slow), trip 2 high (y61.3, faster): varied arrivals must each fire exactly one conversion. Asserts: machine unloaded before each throw; trip 1 converts x 200..203, trip 2 x 204..207.
